// Run in pinned Tempo's tempodb/encoding/vparquet4 package, using its block helpers.
package vparquet4

import (
 "context"
 "encoding/json"
 "os"
 "sort"
 "testing"

 "github.com/gogo/protobuf/jsonpb"
 "github.com/gogo/protobuf/proto"
 "github.com/grafana/tempo/v3/pkg/tempopb"
 cv "github.com/grafana/tempo/v3/pkg/tempopb/common/v1"
 rv "github.com/grafana/tempo/v3/pkg/tempopb/resource/v1"
 tv "github.com/grafana/tempo/v3/pkg/tempopb/trace/v1"
 "github.com/grafana/tempo/v3/pkg/traceql"
 "github.com/grafana/tempo/v3/tempodb/backend"
 "github.com/grafana/tempo/v3/tempodb/encoding/common"
)

func TestPulseTraceDuration(t *testing.T) {
 dir := "/tmp/pulse-tempo-trace-duration"
 if err := os.MkdirAll(dir,0755); err != nil {t.Fatal(err)}
 all := &tempopb.Trace{}
 var rows []*Trace
 // Trace 1's two millisecond spans are more than two hours apart. Trace 2
 // has a single one-second span; trace 3's envelope is 1.003 seconds.
 for i, bounds := range [][][2]uint64{
  {{100000000000,100001000000},{7300000000000,7300002000000}},
  {{101000000000,102000000000}},
  {{102000000000,102001000000},{103000000000,103003000000}},
 } {
  tid := make([]byte,16); tid[15] = byte(i+31)
  tr := &tempopb.Trace{}
  for j,b := range bounds {
   sid := make([]byte,8); sid[7] = byte(j+1)
   name := "request"; var parent []byte
   if j>0 {name="leaf"; parent=make([]byte,8); parent[7]=1}
   sp := &tv.Span{TraceId:tid,SpanId:sid,ParentSpanId:parent,Name:name,Kind:tv.Span_SPAN_KIND_SERVER,StartTimeUnixNano:b[0],EndTimeUnixNano:b[1],Status:&tv.Status{}}
   // One ResourceSpans per span lets HTTP replay publish separate sources.
   r := &tv.ResourceSpans{Resource:&rv.Resource{Attributes:[]*cv.KeyValue{{Key:"service.name",Value:&cv.AnyValue{Value:&cv.AnyValue_StringValue{StringValue:"duration"}}}}},ScopeSpans:[]*tv.ScopeSpans{{Spans:[]*tv.Span{sp}}}}
   tr.ResourceSpans=append(tr.ResourceSpans,r); all.ResourceSpans=append(all.ResourceSpans,r)
  }
  row,_ := traceToParquet(&backend.BlockMeta{},tid,tr,nil); rows=append(rows,row)
 }
 block := makeBackendBlockWithTraces(t,rows)
 queries := []string{
  `{traceDuration > 1s}`, `{trace:duration > 1s}`, `{traceDuration >= 1s}`, `{trace:duration < 1s}`,
  `{traceDuration <= 1s}`, `{trace:duration = 1s}`, `{traceDuration != 1s}`, `{traceDuration = 2h2ms}`,
  `{trace:duration > 2h}`, `{traceDuration > 3h}`, `{duration > 1s}`, `{duration = 1ms}`,
  `{name = "request" && traceDuration > 2h}`, `{name = "leaf" && trace:duration > 2h}`,
  `{name = "request" && traceDuration < 2h}`, `{traceDuration > 2h && duration < 2ms}`,
  `{trace:duration < 2h || name = "leaf"}`, `{traceDuration != 1s && name = "request"}`,
  `{traceDuration > 2h} | select(name)`, `{traceDuration > 2h} > {name = "leaf"}`,
 }
 type Case struct { Query string `json:"query"`; Response json.RawMessage `json:"response"` }
 cases:=[]Case{}
 for _,q := range queries {
  q += " with (most_recent=true)"
  resp,err := traceql.NewEngine().ExecuteSearch(context.Background(),&tempopb.SearchRequest{Query:q,Start:99,End:8000,Limit:100,SpansPerSpanSet:3},traceql.NewSpansetFetcherWrapper(func(ctx context.Context,req traceql.FetchSpansRequest)(traceql.FetchSpansResponse,error){return block.Fetch(ctx,req,common.DefaultSearchOptions())}))
  if err!=nil {t.Fatalf("%s: %v",q,err)}
  resp.Metrics=nil
  for _,tr := range resp.Traces {for _,ss := range tr.SpanSets {for _,sp := range ss.Spans {sort.Slice(sp.Attributes,func(i,j int)bool{return sp.Attributes[i].Key<sp.Attributes[j].Key})}}}
  out,err:=(&jsonpb.Marshaler{}).MarshalToString(resp); if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
  cases=append(cases,Case{q,json.RawMessage(out)})
 }
 input,err:=proto.Marshal(all); if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
 if err=os.WriteFile(dir+"/trace-duration-input.protobuf",input,0644);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 raw,err:=(&jsonpb.Marshaler{}).MarshalToString(all);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if err=os.WriteFile(dir+"/trace-duration-input.json",[]byte(raw),0644);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 out,err:=json.MarshalIndent(cases,"","  ");if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 if err=os.WriteFile(dir+"/trace-duration-oracle.json",out,0644);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
}
